verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a way to export user data such as Warp Drive workflows, notebooks, conversation history or agent run transcripts in open formats. The closest items are adjacent: a settings file for portability between devices (warp-docs-40) and an AGPL-licensed open-source client (warp-docs-25). Neither is a data-export capability, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
